tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas: a near-black with a faint violet tint, so purple and the demos carry the colour (after Fey and Linear). Every page starts here.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Subtle bands: alternate page sections, footer, sticky header after scroll.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, component tiles, code blocks, control panels (elevation 1).

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Raised: dropdowns, popovers, hovered cards, input fields (elevation 2).

tokens.name: surface-4
tokens.usage: Modals, toasts, command palette (elevation 3); also hover fill on surface-3 controls.

tokens.name: surface-5
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected fill on neutral controls; active tab background.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate, never ones that identify: card edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative only (below 3:1 by design).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Boundary of interactive controls (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes). 3.8:1 on surface-3 and 4.3:1 on bg, meets the WCAG 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered control borders and the slider track.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg and every surface (17.8:1 on bg, 14.7:1 on surface-4). Off-white, never #fff.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, descriptions, nav links at rest on bg and surfaces (10.5:1 on bg, 8.7:1 on surface-4).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, section numbers, placeholder text on any surface (6.3:1 on bg, 5.2:1 on surface-4).

tokens.name: grape-1
tokens.usage: Purple-tinted canvas for the hero and marketing bands.

tokens.name: grape-2
tokens.usage: Purple-tinted subtle band; pricing highlight background.

tokens.name: grape-3
tokens.usage: Primary-subtle fill: selected tag, active filter chip, info callout background.

tokens.name: grape-4
tokens.usage: Hovered primary-subtle fill.

tokens.name: grape-5
tokens.usage: Deep plum: the brand's signature dark purple for large brand blocks (CTA band, hero panel). Put text or grape-12 on it.

tokens.name: grape-6
tokens.usage: Pressed primary-subtle fill; selection highlight (::selection) background.

tokens.name: grape-7
tokens.usage: Borders of primary-subtle elements (selected chips, info callouts).

tokens.name: grape-8
tokens.usage: Hovered border of primary-subtle elements.

tokens.name: grape-9
tokens.usage: PRIMARY. Solid fill for the main call to action, active slider thumb, progress. Pair with on-primary (5.9:1).

tokens.name: grape-10
tokens.usage: Hovered primary fill (on-primary still 4.7:1).

tokens.name: grape-11
tokens.usage: Purple text and icons on bg and surfaces (9.3:1 on bg, 7.2:1 on surface-4); links; the focus ring.

tokens.name: grape-12
tokens.usage: High-contrast purple-tinted text, e.g. headings on grape-5 (10.6:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias of grape-9 for components: primary button, slider fill.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Alias of grape-10: primary hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover fills only.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links and purple text on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 8:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon on bg and surfaces (10.4:1); solid badge fill with on-signal text. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon on bg and surfaces (11.4:1); solid fill with on-signal text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text/icon on bg and surfaces (5.2:1 on surface-4); solid fill with on-signal text. Always with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text/icon on bg and surfaces (10:1).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Warm secondary accent: 'New' and 'Free' badges, the weekly-drop marker. Use sparingly, at most one ember element per view.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on solid success, warning, danger, info and ember fills (7.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success callouts and +lines in diffs, under success text.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error callouts and -lines in diffs, under danger text.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning callouts under warning text.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Background of selected rows and active nav items under text.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. Drops to display under 640px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section heroes and the hero on phones.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Try it before you copy it
styles.usage: Page titles: library, component pages, docs.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Production GSAP components in React, Vue and HTML.
styles.usage: Hero sub-copy and lead paragraphs. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every timing, ease and distance is a prop.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Default site UI text: nav, sidebars, buttons, tables, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form and control labels, tabs, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, meta lines, keyboard hints, section numbers (uppercase allowed here only).

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside body text, on surface-3 with radius-sm.

type.note: The site itself is set entirely in JetBrains Mono. Demos are a fictional brand, so they keep Schibsted Grotesk (the sans family) to read as a real product inside the mono frame.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the steps, never in-between values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding-x, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile page gutter, grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Component grid gap, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, diff markers, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tabs, segmented-control items, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, tool chips (the default).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, demo stages, code blocks, control panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the home hero stage only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, slider thumb, toggles.

shadow.note: Edges are 1px light rings (box-shadow), not borders, so they sit inside the radius and stay crisp. Depth comes from lighter surfaces.

tokens.name: ring-hairline
tokens.usage: Default edge of cards, demo stages, code blocks and panels.

tokens.name: ring-button
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, command palette, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary CTA hover only. One glow per view.

duration.note: Motion tokens for the site itself (components ship their own props).

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Color and opacity on hover/press.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, toggles, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, tabs underline, card lift.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, page transitions.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals and hero text splits.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering (GSAP expo.out equivalent).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving across the screen, slider snaps.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only; keep under duration-fast.
